issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error scenarios or edge cases.

scenarios.name: saq-selection-hosted-checkout

scenarios.name: cde-scope-saas-payment-flow
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but omits explicit mention of tokenization, while Response B fails to exclude Stripe.js from the CDE and lacks the required tokenization detail.

scenarios.name: compliance-checklist-braintree-hosted-fields
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric with explicit SAQ A‑EP, all required controls, and a detailed checklist; Response B covers most controls but misidentifies the SAQ type and is less explicit in linking each item to a documented checklist.
